verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's MCP server can read and write "Guides", which are markdown documents capturing org metric definitions and join conventions so agents write more accurate SQL. That is unstructured context for AI agents only, not a governed, declared-once model of metrics, dimensions and joins that both SQL queries and AI tools resolve against. missing for 10: a structured semantic model (metric/dimension/join definitions), governance or enforcement of definitions, consistent use by non-AI queries and BI tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
